verdict: Close to break-even: at 1.26R the target must come first in 44% of the replays that hit a side; it did in 42% (target first 40.4% vs stop first 55.8%).
plain: We replayed the trading window 5,000 times using this market's own recent price moves. The first target was reached before the safety exit in 40% of replays, the safety exit was hit first in 56%, and in 4% neither happened in time. In real history (59 past starts), the same distances hit the target first 16 times and the stop first 24 times. Overall: about a coin flip once the reward size is counted.
caveat: A simulation from recent bars, not a prediction. News, earnings and gaps can do what the last 60 days never did.
